heading: Source
reported_value: Univ. Antwerp (PLASMANT); BELSPO and IWT funding; no competing-interest statement
evidence_excerpt_or_description: Koen Van Laer* and Annemie Bogaerts
notes: published version (Wiley typeset), UAntwerp repository copy

heading: Reactor configuration
reported_value: coaxial DBD: grounded SS inner rod 8 mm; Al2O3 tube ID 17 / OD 22 mm with Ni foil HV electrode; length 90 mm; gap 4.5 mm; discharge volume 15.9 cm3
evidence_excerpt_or_description: The discharge gap ... was fixed at 4.5 mm, which resulted in a discharge volume of 15.9 cm3

heading: Reactor configuration
reported_value: ZrO2 beads (SiLi-Beads), dielectric constant 22-25, five size ranges 0.90-1.00 to 2.00-2.24 mm; empty reactor as benchmark
evidence_excerpt_or_description: The experiments with packing were performed with five different bead size ranges (diameters of 0.90-1.00, 1.00-1.18, 1.25-1.40, 1.60-1.80, and 2.00-2.24 mm)

heading: Electricity supply
reported_value: AC HV power supply (AFS); three 'applied powers' 60, 80, 100 W; plasma model at 3.5 kV p-p, 23.5 kHz
evidence_excerpt_or_description: Experiments were performed at three different gas flow rates (20, 50, and 100 mL min-1) and three different applied powers (60, 80, and 100 W)
notes: 'applied power' not defined (supply input or setpoint); plasma power per point not reported

heading: Operating conditions
reported_value: pure CO2, 20, 50, 100 mL/min (Bronkhorst MFC); atmospheric pressure; plasma on 20 min before GC
evidence_excerpt_or_description: we ignited the plasma 20 min before our GC measurements to ensure that the plasma reactor is in steady state
notes: purity and flow reference conditions not stated

heading: Performance indicators
reported_value: three-channel compact GC (2 TCD, FID); X = (CO2_in - CO2_out)/CO2_in using a no-plasma reference signal; CO and O2 selectivities ~50%; no carbon deposits; O3 not detected
evidence_excerpt_or_description: Benchmark measurements, without plasma treatment, were also performed to measure the CO2 signal at the inlet

heading: Electricity supply
reported_value: P_plasma = (1/T) integral V(t) I(t) dt; HV probe P6015A, Rogowski Pearson 4100, PicoScope; charge from external capacitor
evidence_excerpt_or_description: The plasma power itself is calculated from the instantaneous applied potential V(t) and the measured current I(t) over one period T

heading: Performance indicators
reported_value: eta = dH X / (SEI x molar volume); SEI = P_plasma x 60 / flow; dH = 279.8 kJ/mol (2.9 eV)
evidence_excerpt_or_description: The reaction enthalpy (DHR) is 279.8 kJ mol-1 or 2.9 eV molec-1

heading: Performance indicators
reported_value: X 42.0%, eta 4.7%; largest beads (2.00-2.24 mm), 20 mL/min, 80 W applied; x1.6 conversion and x1.9 efficiency vs empty
evidence_excerpt_or_description: The maximum conversion obtained in this study is 42.0 %, which is reached with the largest bead size at the lowest flow rate (20 mL min-1) with 80 W of applied power. The energy efficiency under these conditions is 4.7 %

heading: Performance indicators
reported_value: eta 9.6% at X 10.0%; 1.6-1.8 mm, 100 mL/min, 60 W applied; x1.5 efficiency and x1.1 conversion vs empty
evidence_excerpt_or_description: The maximum energy efficiency obtained is 9.6 %, which is reached with the highest flow rate (100 mL min-1), the lowest applied power (60 W), and bead sizes of 1.6-1.8 mm diameter, but it corresponds to a conversion of only 10.0 %

heading: Performance indicators
reported_value: X 37.8%, eta 6.4%; 1.60-1.80 mm, 60 W applied, 20 mL/min; 1.9x and 1.8x the empty reactor
evidence_excerpt_or_description: The conversion at this point reaches 37.8 % with a corresponding energy efficiency of 6.4 %, which is 1.9 and 1.8 times higher than that without a packing
notes: empty reactor at same conditions implied: X ~19.9%, eta ~3.6%

heading: Performance indicators
reported_value: larger beads help at 60-80 W, small beads can lower performance; conversion falls above 80 W (filamentary transition suggested); lower flow raises X, lowers eta
evidence_excerpt_or_description: if the applied power is above 80 W, the conversion for almost all bead sizes, especially the larger ones, decreases

heading: Performance indicators
reported_value: atmospheric MW (Spencer & Gallimore): 45% at 5%, 21% at 10%; reverse-vortex GA: 18-43% at 2-9%; MW and GA handle 16 and 40 L/min
evidence_excerpt_or_description: An atmospheric-pressure reverse-vortex-flow gliding-arc discharge can reach higher energy efficiencies (18-43 %). However, the accompanying conversion is limited to 2-9 %
notes: authors' argument: packed-bed DBD easier to combine with catalysts

heading: Electricity supply
field: plasma power implied by reported X and eta
evidence_excerpt_or_description: SEI = dH X / (eta Vm); P = SEI x flow / 60; Vm 24.5 or 22.414 L/mol
notes: plasma power is about a third to a half of the 'applied power'

heading: Performance indicators
field: energy per CO and applied-power basis
normalized_value: EC_CO (plasma): OP001 54.2, OP002 73.8, OP003 36.1, OP004 97.5 kWh/Nm3; eta on applied power: 2.4, 2.0, 3.2, 1.3%
evidence_excerpt_or_description: EC = dH/eta; eta_applied = X dH F / P_applied (24.5 L/mol)

heading: Gaps
normalized_value: if X is uncorrected: OP001 37.8 -> 28.8%; OP002 42.0 -> 32.6%; OP003 10.0 -> 6.9%; OP004 19.9 -> 14.2% (efficiency scales likewise)
evidence_excerpt_or_description: y_CO2,out = (1 - X)/(1 + X/2) with X_app = 1 - y_CO2,out
uncertainty: applies only if the GC signal ratio was used without correction (method implies so; not stated)
notes: the expansion issue is the subject of RV003 (Wanten et al. 2023)

heading: Performance indicators
normalized_value: OP001 71.0; OP002 95.2; OP003 52.4; OP004 136.6 kWh/Nm3 CO (plasma power)
evidence_excerpt_or_description: EC_CO = EC_CO2 x X_reported / X_corrected (E041, E043)
basis_and_boundary: plasma power implied from reported X and eta
notes: Used in the synthesis and manuscript figure from 2026-11-26 (BB decision, for consistency with Kim 2014 SRC028)
